description: This Java class 'DefaultAmqp10Config' provides the default implementation for configuration settings related to AMQP 1.0 messaging, including connection parameters, throttling, backoff strategies, and timeout settings within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultAmqp10Config
classes.description: Immutable class implementing Amqp10Config, encapsulating AMQP 1.0 messaging configuration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultAmqp10Config from a given Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: isConsumerRateLimitEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether consumer rate limiting is enabled.

methods.name: getConsumerMaxInFlight
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of in-flight consumer messages.

methods.name: getConsumerRedeliveryExpectationTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for consumer redelivery expectation.

methods.name: getConsumerThrottlingConfig
methods.description: Returns the throttling configuration for consumers.

methods.name: getProducerCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the cache size for producers.

methods.name: getPublisherParallelism
methods.description: Returns the parallelism level for message publishing.

methods.name: getGlobalConnectTimeout
methods.description: Returns the global connection timeout duration.

methods.name: getGlobalSendTimeout
methods.description: Returns the global send timeout duration.

methods.name: getGlobalRequestTimeout
methods.description: Returns the global request timeout duration.

methods.name: getGlobalPrefetchPolicyAllCount
methods.description: Returns the global prefetch policy count.
